page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. It is configured with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps and does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed provide a stable resource density suitable for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of bundled local storage or GPU hardware.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-frequency dedicated processors, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and medium-scale database hosting where local storage is not a prerequisite.
